password.title: 修改密码
Change password
password.hint: 修改成功后，当前页面保持登录，其他设备需重新登录。
You will stay signed in here. Other devices will need to sign in again.
password.saved: 密码已修改，其他会话已退出。
Password changed. Other sessions have been signed out.
password.adminHint: 已有密码无法查看。重置后，该用户的其他会话需重新登录。
Existing passwords cannot be viewed. Resetting a password signs out that user’s other sessions.
